title: ChocoLin's Optimize
description: An Modpacks centered around VulkanMod[以Vulkanmod为核心的优化整合包]
body:
An Modpacks centered around VulkanMod

- **Performance** 

VulkanMod enables Minecraft to use Vulkan for rendering instead of OpenGL, and when combined with other modern optimization mods, the performance will be enhanced. 

- **Support most of the functions of Optifine** 

Supports most of the features of OptiFine, including connected textures and scaling. If your resource pack states "requires OptiFine", it is likely that it can also be used here. 

- **Deficiencies** 

1. Does not support shaders
2. Extremely low compatibility - this may prevent you from freely adding the mods you like!
3. Extremely low stability 

- **Contact Me**

You can send your opinions to the email address _3119723649@qq.com_, and I will do my best to resolve the issue.

///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

以vulkanmod为核心的整合包

- **性能**

vulkanmod让Minecraft使用vulkan进行渲染而非OpenGL，再结合其他现代优化模组，性能会有提升

- **支持Optifine的大部分功能**

支持大部分OptiFine功能，包括连接纹理和缩放。如果你的资源包写着“需要OptiFine”，这里很可能也能用

- **不足**

1. 不支持着色器
2. 极低的兼容性——这让您可能无法自由得添加您喜欢的模组！
3. 极低的稳定性

- **联系我:**

可以将您的意见发送至电子邮箱 _3119723649@qq.com_ ，我会全力解决
